title: Self-RAG: Part 2 - The 4 Reflection Tokens: Retrieve, IsRel, IsSup, IsUse

beats.text: Why do GPUs sit idle during LLM inference until Self-RAG unlocks 98.2% throughput?
The core challenge? Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), an ad hoc approach that augments LMs with retrieval of relevant knowledge, decreases such issues.
beats.visual_focus: Bottleneck diagram illustrating resource contention and latency walls.

beats.text: Enter Self-RAG: however, indiscriminately retrieving and incorporating a fixed number of retrieved passages, regardless of whether retrieval is necessary, or passages are relevant, diminishes LM versatility or can lead to unhelpful response generation.

beats.text: The result? Our framework trains a single arbitrary LM that adaptively retrieves passages on-demand, and generates and reflects on retrieved passages and its own generations using special tokens, called reflection tokens.
